subject: Request: temporary authority lift & onboarding forms for Evergrowth
messages:
From: Linda Sanchez <linda.sanchez@evergrowth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@evergrowth.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: EverGrowth onboarding — procurement forms & PO requirement?

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited to run the six-week pilot. Procurement flagged that Redwood requires a PO on file for all vendors, which will slow our timeline (our finance team needs ~2 weeks to issue a PO).

Given we expect under $7k in spend for the pilot, can you help escalate or provide a short-term exception so we can start immediately while our PO is processed?

I've attached: EverGrowth-W9.pdf and our completed onboarding form (EverGrowth-onboarding-form.pdf). Billing contact is Eva Park (eva.park@evergrowth.com).

Ideal path: a 30-day temporary authorization to invoice without PO, capped at $10k, then switch to standard PO-based billing when the PO is issued. If you need any vendor verification docs we can provide them quickly.

Best,
Linda Sanchez\Procurement Lead\Evergrowth, Inc.
Attachments: EverGrowth-W9.pdf, EverGrowth-onboarding-form.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Linda Sanchez <linda.sanchez@evergrowth.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 13:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EverGrowth onboarding — procurement forms & PO requirement?

Hi Linda — great to hear the pilot is moving forward. Appreciate you sending the W9 and the onboarding form. I reviewed the fields and we have what we need to start the vendor intake.

Quick context: our global PO policy requires a PO for recurring/contracted spend, but there is a standard exceptions process for short pilots. Procurement (cc'd: Priya) usually evaluates:
- risk tier (vendor jurisdiction, prior relationship)
- invoice routing & PO timing
- evidence (W9, bank verification, signed SOW/MSA when applicable)

Next steps I can own this side:
1) Priya — can you confirm whether we can approve a temporary no-PO authority for the Evergrowth pilot while they secure a PO?
2) Linda — could you confirm the billing contact and provide an expected PO issuance date (best estimate)?
3) Linda — please complete the short vendor intake here: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/vendor-intake (one-page).

If procurement prefers, we can limit the exception to a $10k cap and 30 days. Happy to set an internal canary if usage looks high and automatically pause the trial.

Thanks,
Rafael\Account Executive\Redwood Inference

Hi all — looping in procurement for intake. Thanks for the attachments, Linda; W9 on file is helpful. A few clarifying items before procurement can sign off on any temporary authority: 

1) Confirm billing contact and where invoices should be sent (invoice@example vs AP portal).
2) Expected PO issuance date or purchasing contact so we can coordinate.
3) Any copy of a signed SOW or email acceptance from your legal ops team.

Per our exceptions matrix, procurement can approve a temporary "no-PO" authorization under these controls: 
- Maximum cap: $10,000 total during the pilot period
- Timebox: 30 calendar days from the invoice date
- Invoice routing: invoices must still include the Redwood project code and be submitted to a designated AP inbox (we require visibility)
- Evidence: signed onboarding form, W9, and a named purchasing contact

I can provisionally approve this request pending verification of the above. I attached our temp-authority-worksheet.xlsx (stub) to record the controls. Please reply with the billing contact and PO ETA and we can finalize.

Priya Natarajan\Senior Procurement Manager\Redwood Inference
Attachments: temp-authority-worksheet.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: linda.sanchez@evergrowth.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EverGrowth onboarding — procurement forms & PO requirement?

Thanks for the clear thread. Priya — thanks for laying out the controls. I'm authorizing a temporary, limited exception to allow Evergrowth to begin the pilot immediately under the following firm conditions: 

- Cap: $10,000 total across all invoices for the pilot.
- Duration: 30 days starting from the first invoice date.
- Required evidence to be uploaded to vendor intake within 3 business days: W9 (received), onboarding form (received), and confirmation of PO ETA or purchasing contact.
- Billing contact: Eva Park (eva.park@evergrowth.com) — invoices must be sent to ap+evergrowth@redwood.com and include project code RW-EVG-PILOT.
- Automatic pause: If spend rate indicates >50% of cap within first 7 days, account will be paused and procurement will escalate.

Marissa — please kick off onboarding (account creation, project code, usage alerts) once the intake is uploaded and link the DocuSign MSA placeholder; I'll sign the temporary authority form in our system. Linda — please confirm PO ETA by end of week; if PO isn't forthcoming we will escalate and reassess.

Approver: Jonas Weber, VP, Finance Operations\Redwood Inference
